title: Astra Half Marathon 2026 Review: What the 2025 Race Was Like
seo_title: Astra Half Marathon Review: BSD Course, Humidity, Cut-offs
meta_description: Astra Half Marathon review: the 2025 race at BSD City, 26°C and a 24°C dew point at the 5am start, a 3.5-hour cut-off, eight water stations, insurance, and who can enter.
dek: What running the Astra Half Marathon in BSD City was like in 2025: the course, the humidity at the start, the aid and medical cover, the cut-offs, the pace at the front, and the entry rules that surprise visitors.
verdict: Enter if you are an Indonesian runner who wants a well-supported half marathon in Greater Jakarta with a generous limit. The 2025 race drew more than 5,000 runners to BSD City, gave the half marathon 3.5 hours, and put eight water stations, two fruit and two sponge stations and twelve ambulances on the route, with every entrant insured. One runner called the course relatively flat and the marshalling strict. The catches: entry is for Indonesian citizens only, race packs are collected in central Jakarta rather than BSD, and the air is humid, 26°C with a 24°C dew point at the 5am start. Pace for the humidity and plan a Jakarta trip for your pack.

sections.heading: The Course: Out-and-Backs on BSD City's Boulevards
paragraphs: The half marathon starts and finishes on Jl. BSD Boulevard Utara, where it meets Jl. BSD Utama, beside Astra Biz Center [1]. It loops north along Jl. Lkr. Botanika Selatan and Jl. Lkr. Botanika Utara to Jl. Bumi Botanika at about 4 km, then turns south down Jl. BSD Raya Pusat to Jl. BSD Grand Boulevard, where it turns back between 8 and 9 km [1].

The second half has a long out-and-back west along Jl. BSD Boulevard Utara, with the turn at 13 km, before returning north on Jl. BSD Raya Pusat, east along Jl. Bumi Botanika at 16 to 17 km, back down Jl. Lkr. Botanika Utara at 18 km and home through Jl. Majorie Ave at 20 km [1]. Several roads, including Jl. BSD Raya Pusat and Jl. Lkr. Botanika Utara, are run twice [1].

The official map has no elevation profile [1]. One half-marathon runner described the route as relatively flat [2]. The organiser's route file is labelled as a PASI-measured revision dated 2 October 2025 [3], and for 2026 the routes for all three distances have been certified by the national athletics federation, PB PASI [4].

sections.heading: The Weather: Humid at the Start, 30°C by 8.30am
paragraphs: Soekarno-Hatta airport, about 18 km north of the start, recorded 26°C at 5am on race morning, with a dew point of 24°C, 89% humidity and a 6-knot wind [5]. It held at 26°C until 6am, then climbed: 28°C at 7am, 29°C at 7.30am and 30°C, with 66% humidity, at 8.30am [5].

A dew point of 24°C means sweat evaporates slowly, so expect to run slower than on a cool morning. Even so, the reports from the day were positive: detik described the weather as friendly from the 5am start [6], the men's winner, Agus Prayogo, called it good [6], and one runner wrote that it was comfortable [2].
The race started at 5am [6]. If the half marathon set off then, its 3.5-hour cut-off fell at 8.30am, so a runner near the limit finished in 30°C air [5].

sections.heading: Aid Stations, Cooling and Medical Cover
paragraphs: The organiser listed eight hydration points, two fruit stations, two sponging stations, nine cheering areas, seven mobile medics and twelve ambulances on the route and at the race centre [7]. The official map shows the eight water stations spread around the course, with the fruit and sponge stations on Jl. BSD Raya Pusat near 11 km and on Jl. Lkr. Botanika Utara near 18 km [1]. detik reported water every two kilometres [6]; the organiser's 2026 FAQ gives the spacing as every 2.5 km, with an ambulance every 5 km [8].

One runner singled out the fruit and cold sponge stations and called the water stations complete [2]. Every entrant was insured through Astra Life: up to Rp2.5 million of hospital costs for sports injuries, including muscle injuries, dehydration and heat stroke, and Rp25 million of life cover [7]. Halodoc also offered participants a health screening before the race [7].

sections.heading: Cut-offs, Roads and Marshals
paragraphs: The cut-offs were 3.5 hours for the half marathon, 2 hours for the 10 km and 1 hour for the 5 km in the 2024 rules [9], and they are the same in the 2026 FAQ [8]. Finishing inside the limit mattered in 2025: only runners who met the cut-off were eligible for the prize draw, worth Rp200 million in total and including a Honda ICON e electric scooter [7].

Agus Prayogo called the route steril (sterile) and said 2025 was the third year of taking part [10]. A runner wrote that marshalling was strict and traffic was not a problem [2]. For 2026 the organiser says it is preparing traffic management for the race, and runners must stay on the official route and pass every checkpoint or risk disqualification [4][8].

sections.heading: How Fast the Field Is
paragraphs: Agus Prayogo, a national athlete and the race's brand ambassador, won the men's half marathon [10] in 1:18:19 [11]. Further down the field, one runner who had aimed for 1:40 finished in 1:38 [12].

Prize money is paid three deep in four separate categories: men and women, each split into Astra employees and the public. In 2025 the half marathon paid Rp10 million, Rp8 million and Rp6 million; the 10 km Rp7 million, Rp6 million and Rp4 million; and the 5 km Rp4 million, Rp3 million and Rp2 million [13]. Winners are decided on gun time [8].

sections.heading: Race Weekend Logistics
paragraphs: Race packs were not collected in BSD. In 2025 collection was on Friday and Saturday, 28 and 29 November, from 10am to 7pm at Catur Dharma Hall on the fifth floor of Menara Astra on Jl. Jenderal Sudirman in central Jakarta, and you needed your confirmation email and ID [13]. For 2026 the organiser says there is no race-day collection and no delivery [8].

The event ran from 4am to noon [13], and the start area was already filling at 4am [10]. For 2026 runner parking is at QBig Mall [8]. Entry cost Rp600,000 for the half marathon, Rp450,000 for the 10 km and Rp395,000 for the 5 km in 2025 [13]; the 2026 fees are Rp650,000, Rp500,000 and Rp400,000 [8]. Every finisher got a medal and an e-certificate, and half-marathon finishers also got a finisher jacket [13].

Entry is limited to Indonesian citizens: the 2024 rules said so [9], and the 2026 FAQ opens every distance only to Indonesian citizens aged 13 to 70 [8]. Entries cannot be refunded or transferred [8].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you are an Indonesian runner looking for a well-supported half marathon near Jakarta, especially a first one: the 3.5-hour limit is generous, the aid and medical cover are thorough, and official pacers are planned for sub-2:00, sub-2:30 and sub-3:00 [8].

Think twice if you are not an Indonesian citizen, because you cannot enter, or if a trip into central Jakarta to collect your pack is a problem. If you want a fast time, remember that the dew point was already 24°C at the 2025 start.

The 2026 race is on Sunday 29 November at Astra Biz Center [8]. Flag-off times for each distance will be published in the race guide [8], and the half-marathon route file on the 2026 page is still the 2025 revision [14][3], so check the final route when the guide appears.
Nobody from this site ran the race. This review draws on the organiser's race pages, rules and route maps, airport weather records, Indonesian news reports, and two runners' own accounts.

faqs.question: Can foreigners run the Astra Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: No. The race is open only to Indonesian citizens. The 2024 rules required participants to be Indonesian nationals, and the 2026 FAQ opens the half marathon, 10 km and 5 km only to Indonesian citizens aged 13 to 70. Visitors looking for a half marathon in the Jakarta area will need a different race.

faqs.question: What is the cut-off at the Astra Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: Three and a half hours for the half marathon, two hours for the 10 km and one hour for the 5 km. Those limits appear in both the 2024 rules and the 2026 FAQ. In 2025 only runners who finished inside the cut-off were eligible for the Rp200 million prize draw.

faqs.question: How hot is the Astra Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: Warm and humid at dawn. At the 5am start in 2025, Soekarno-Hatta airport recorded 26°C with a 24°C dew point and 89% humidity. It reached 28°C by 7am and 30°C by 8.30am. The winner and a runner still called the weather good, but pace for the humidity.

faqs.question: Where do you collect the Astra Half Marathon race pack?
faqs.answer: In central Jakarta, not in BSD. In 2025 packs were collected on the Friday and Saturday before the race at Catur Dharma Hall, Menara Astra, on Jl. Jenderal Sudirman, with your confirmation email and ID. The 2026 FAQ says there is no race-day collection and no delivery.

faqs.question: Is the Astra Half Marathon course flat?
faqs.answer: One runner described it as relatively flat. The half marathon loops through BSD City from Astra Biz Center, with out-and-backs on Jl. BSD Raya Pusat and Jl. BSD Boulevard Utara. The official map has no elevation profile. Agus Prayogo won the men's race in 1:18:19 in 2025.

editorial_notes: Rewritten 2026-09-28 about the previous race (Sunday 30 November 2025). Weather is from airport METAR observations, not a forecast. Full results sit on RaceTec behind a bot check, so there is no top ten, finisher count or women's winner. No per-distance flag-off times were published for 2025; detik gives a 5am start. The 2025 cut-offs are taken from the 2024 rules and the 2026 FAQ, which match. detik reported water every 2 km, the organiser's FAQ says every 2.5 km, and the official map shows eight water stations; the map figure is used. The runners quoted from Instagram are not named. No rating.
